# 玉籙大齋第二日晚朝儀-宋

**ID:** KR5b0206
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0206

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Sixth of the eight-part **Yùlù dàzhāi** programme (DZ 505 a–h). The evening audience of day 2 stands at the structural pivot of the three-day fast — the close of the central day, after which the rite turns toward the concluding *jìyōu* salvation phase.

**Abstract**

The evening rite closes the day with the final ninth *huí* of the central scripture-recitation cycle, plus a transitional *huíxiàng* anticipating the next day's *jìyōu pànhú* salvation rite ([KR5b0209](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0209)). The text retains the standard *wǎncháo* dedications to the *yīnfǔ* deities and the *gūyōu* of the *jiǔyōu*. Following the dedication, the rite includes the special evening *xiètiāndì* 謝天地 (thanksgiving to Heaven and Earth) which seals the salvific *huí* of the day. The structural symmetry of the *Yùlù* programme — three days × three audiences × three incense-pinches — makes this fascicle the deepest interior point of the rite, the one furthest from both the opening *sùqǐ* and the closing *yángōng* 言功.
